display.purpose: Literal destination title with roman/italic phrases; responsive sizes are documented in DESIGN.md.

body.purpose: Overview reading text; not a universal browser body-size override.

label.purpose: Base filled and text actions; compact overrides remain local.

practical.purpose: Packing labels, entry field, and map detail text.

supporting.purpose: Map supporting text and packing persistence/reset row; do not shrink to incidental caption sizes.

shadows.name: mobile-navigation
shadows.purpose: Expanded mobile menu only; not a card elevation scale.

motion.name: control-feedback
motion.purpose: CSS button background/lift, tool wash, nav underline, chevron rotation, and photo-expand opacity; filled-button hover translates Y by -2px.

motion.name: photo-hover
motion.purpose: Gallery image scales to 1.035 on hover.

motion.name: scroll-cue
motion.purpose: Arrow drifts from Y 0 to 4px and back.

motion.name: hero-photo
motion.purpose: Motion image scale 1.035 to 1; source library easing name, not a CSS timing function.

motion.name: hero-title
motion.purpose: Motion Y 22px to 0 and opacity 0.65 to 1; no explicit easing override.

motion.name: section-reveal
motion.purpose: Once-in-view Y 16px to 0 and opacity 0.85 to 1; content starts present, initial=false.

motion.name: day-selection
motion.purpose: Timeline Y 8px to 0 and opacity 0.55 to 1; activity reveal delay is min(index * 0.03s, 0.18s).

motion.name: activity-detail
motion.purpose: Expand/collapse height and opacity; zero duration with reduced motion.

motion.name: gallery-dialog
motion.purpose: Backdrop fade; zero duration with reduced motion.

motion.name: map-travel
motion.purpose: Leaflet travel animation; animate=false under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: CSS disables animations/transitions and smooth scrolling, resets hero transform and photo hover scale; MotionConfig reducedMotion=user plus component checks suppress nonessential movement. CSS button hover lift remains an immediate state change, not an animation.

components.name: Light Button
components.description: Paper action over photography; standalone specimen retains the source hover lift and focus ring.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-light">Khám phá hành trình<svg aria-hidden="true" width="19" height="19" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M7 17 17 7M7 7h10v10"/></svg></button>

components.name: Green Button
components.description: Filled practical action. Reset confirmation uses the source's compact local override, not a third button variant.

components.name: Text Action
components.description: Inline reset action shown at the repaired packing-row size; underline communicates hover.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-text" aria-expanded="false"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 11a9 9 0 1 1 2.7 6.4M3 4v7h7"/></svg>Bỏ chọn tất cả</button>

components.name: Circular Tool
components.description: Outlined previous/next-day tool with accessible name, native title, hover, and disabled treatment.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-tool" aria-label="Ngày tiếp theo" title="Ngày tiếp theo"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12h14m-7-7 7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>

components.name: Packing Input
components.description: Underline entry field with adjacent add tool. Native HTML specimen omits application submission logic.
components.css: .ds-add{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;border-bottom:1px solid #bbc9af}.ds-hidden{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap}.ds-add input{flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;background:transparent;padding:10px 0;color:var(--ink,#243b32);caret-color:var(--green,#294d3f);font:400 12px/1.6 'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif;letter-spacing:0}.ds-add input::placeholder{color:#596a53}.ds-add button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:42px;height:42px;flex-shrink:0;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#243b32);cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s}.ds-add button:hover:not(:disabled){background:#e8edde}.ds-add input:focus-visible,.ds-add button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #bb873e;outline-offset:5px}.ds-add button:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.38}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-add button{transition:none}}

components.name: Selected Day
components.description: One selected tab specimen; dates remain prominent. Existing small day/weekday metadata is contextual, not a future practical-text scale. Roving focus and selection logic belong to the app.
components.css: .ds-days{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(82px,220px);border-block:1px solid var(--line,#dcded5)}.ds-days button{position:relative;min-height:110px;padding:18px 24px;text-align:left;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#626b62);font:400 13px/1.6 'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif;letter-spacing:0;cursor:pointer}.ds-days button[aria-selected=true]{background:#edf0e7;color:var(--green,#294d3f)}.ds-days button[aria-selected=true]:after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:var(--green,#294d3f)}.ds-days button>span,.ds-days button>small{display:block;font-size:9px}.ds-days strong{font-family:var(--serif,'Noto Serif Display',Georgia,serif);font-size:28px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5}.ds-days button:hover{cursor:pointer}.ds-days button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #bb873e;outline-offset:5px}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-days button{min-height:96px;padding:14px 10px}.ds-days strong{font-size:22px;white-space:nowrap}.ds-days button>span,.ds-days button>small{font-size:8px}}

components.name: Packing Check
components.description: Native checkbox and complete label target with visible checked mark, strike-through, and local focus outline; usable without JavaScript.
components.css: .ds-pack{display:flex;position:relative;align-items:center;gap:9px;min-height:34px;padding:7px 0;color:var(--ink,#243b32);font:400 12px/1.5 'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif;letter-spacing:0;cursor:pointer}.ds-pack input{position:absolute;opacity:0;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;margin:0;cursor:pointer}.ds-check{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:15px;height:15px;flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid #86977c;border-radius:2px;background:#f7f9f2}.ds-check svg{visibility:hidden}.ds-pack input:checked~.ds-check{background:var(--green,#294d3f);border-color:var(--green,#294d3f);color:white}.ds-pack input:checked~.ds-check svg{visibility:visible}.ds-pack input:checked~span:last-child{text-decoration:line-through;color:#617158}.ds-pack>span:last-child{overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-pack:hover{cursor:pointer}.ds-pack input:focus-visible~.ds-check{outline:2px solid var(--ochre,#b67632);outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-pack{min-height:44px;gap:8px}}

narrative.overview:
A cinematic Vietnamese travel magazine: real destination photography, warm paper, forest ink, muted landscape accents, and a roman/italic serif voice. Content-led, unframed bands balance an expressive photographic opening with quiet, practical travel tools.

Photography is illustrative destination imagery, not evidence of personal trip memories. Preserve its labeling and credits. Visual storytelling must not delay access to source-faithful travel information.
keyCharacteristics: Real illustrative photography with visible provenance.
Vietnamese-capable editorial serif and practical sans-serif.
Unframed bands, quiet dividers, compact functional controls.
Restrained motion with a complete reduced-motion path.

rules.name: The Source Palette Rule
rules.body: Use observed roles; generated sidecar tonal ramps are preview aids, not additional UI colors.

rules.name: The Practical Text Rule
rules.body: Preserve the repaired map name/support/detail hierarchy (14px/11px/12px), packing labels (12px), and persistence/reset row (11px). Smaller existing folios, credits, and day metadata are local exceptions, not a recommended scale for new actionable or essential information.

dos: Do use real destination photography with illustrative labels and credits.
Do preserve Vietnamese glyph coverage and the roman/italic serif pairing.
Do keep practical information readable, keyboard reachable, and available without motion or a working map.
Do use unframed content bands and reserve framing for the actual map tool and modal viewer.
donts: Don't imply illustrative photos are personal memories or invent trip facts and precise map locations.
Don't turn incidental tiny captions into future practical-text defaults.
Don't replace compact controls with decorative pills, nested cards, or a dashboard composition.
Don't add invented palette roles, elevation levels, or motion that obstructs reading.
